records.recommendation: 40 stations passing the regional least-disturbed screen (watershed agriculture up to 25 percent, the screen's floor, with the relaxed tier's other limits) from Level II 7.1 (Marine West Coast Forest), 38 of them inside this ecoregion. Borrowed stations were matched to this ecoregion's streams on base flow index, runoff, surficial lithology. Flagged transfer: the recovery test did not confirm this source for this ecoregion. In the recovery test the source's class calls did not agree with reference often enough and the source promoted sites systematically. The test found class agreement 0.53 of 17 evaluation regions, where two thirds over at least 4 regions is required; net optimism +0.17, where at most 0.05 is allowed. No source passed the validated acceptance criteria for this metric here, so the pool is used under the flagged-transfer rung as the narrowest comparable pool with at least the adequate floor of usable comparable stations that passes the sample, stability and comparability checks. The curve carries transfer risk unvalidated and its confidence is capped at 39; read the condition band with that limitation in mind.

computed.why: No national or regional assessment publishes a condition benchmark for bank angle, sinuosity, bankfull height or the bankfull width to depth ratio as NRSA measures them. The state stream quantification tools rate channel and floodplain dynamics on the bank height ratio and on the share of eroding or armored bank, field measurements this archive does not carry. Where no station pool supports this metric the function is completed by measuring the bank height ratio at the assessment reach and scoring it on the published curve for the state (the Minnesota and Wisconsin tools, verified against their originals) or on the national Stream Functions Pyramid standard (1.0 to 1.2 functioning, above 1.5 not functioning), entered as a provisional source with its citation.
